purpose: This table provides hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, and visibility) for NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for the 2013 year, cleaned from the raw Airbyte-captured bronze landing to feed downstream flight-delay and weather-correlation analyses.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to align weather conditions with flight events at the same airport and hour; consumers must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, pressure, and especially wind_gust (74.6% null) rather than assuming zero or average values, since nulls are retained as-is from source.
limitations: wind_gust is sparsely populated (null_rate 0.745505) and should not be treated as reliably present; pressure (null_rate 0.114953) and wind_dir (null_rate 0.016828) also carry meaningful null rates. No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied, but the origin/time_hour grain has not been measured for uniqueness against the full warehouse and should be validated before being relied upon as a true primary key.
